issue.title: bob periods brief closed-period No-linked-minutes list is unfiltered first-7 by path with no tail
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/native/periods/brief.rs`, past branch of `still_open_section` (and `docs/periods.md` §Agent briefs item 7 documents the behaviour)

For a closed period, `bob periods brief <week> -f md` builds Still open → "No linked minutes" by sorting every open task with a block id and no linked minutes by source path, then cutting to the first 7 rows with no `+N more` tail, with no Next/WIP lane filter.

Repro: `bob periods brief 2026-W45 -f md` (week closed, review empty). The "No linked minutes" list is the first 7 `bob.md` tasks alphabetically (`ch-jumper-keymaps`, `ctrl-l-keymap`, `mac-cmd`, `bob-sync`, `better-roadmaps`, `magic-char-glossary-term`, `work-log-keymap`), not stalled Next or WIP tasks, with no count behind the cap.

Impact: the weekly v1 callout asks for stalled Next or WIP tasks, so drafts cannot use this list and must omit it (as the 2026-W45 draft does). Fixing it (keep a usable lane snapshot vs. change the list or callout wording) is a design choice.

task_type_fields.impact: Weekly Review drafts cannot use the list for stalled Next/WIP tasks and must omit it
task_type_fields.repro: bob periods brief 2026-W45 -f md: Still open No linked minutes shows first 7 bob.md tasks by source path, no +N more, no lane filter

issue.creation_reason: Drafting the 2026-W45 Review surfaced that the closed-period No-linked-minutes list cannot feed the weekly callout's stalled Next/WIP section.

payload.description: Both edit still_open_section in brief.rs; gu fixed as-of-date, this covers lane filter and cap tail
